title: Device-creation matrix (Agility vs OS, debug layer, Options5) with logging
purpose: Systematically identify which combination triggers STATUS_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION during device creation.

steps.detail: Add a build-time and env toggle to disable Agility and use OS D3D12Core; log selection.
Add command-line arg or env to disable/enable D3D12 debug layer and DXGI factory debug; log state.
Wrap CheckFeatureSupport(Options5) with try/catch + HRESULT checks; log results only if device was created.
Print one-line summary row for each run: {agility=[on|off], debug=[on|off], tier=[value]|fail, result=[ok|crash|hr]}

acceptance: We can run 2-3 permutations and see whether illegal instruction correlates with Agility on/off or debug on/off
A clear console log row shows the device creation path and outcome
